changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION landvault_detect_estate_conflicts( p_estate_id uuid, p_min_overlap_sqm numeric ) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ WITH candidate AS ( SELECT LEAST(s.id, e.id) AS left_id, GREATEST(s.id, e.id) AS right_id, CASE WHEN s.id < e.id THEN s.tenant_id ELSE e.tenant_id END AS left_tenant, CASE WHEN s.id < e.id THEN e.tenant_id ELSE s.tenant_id END AS right_tenant, ST_Area(ST_Intersection(s.footprint, e.footprint)::geography)::numeric AS overlap_sqm, CASE WHEN s.id < e.id THEN ST_Area(s.footprint::geography)::numeric ELSE ST_Area(e.footprint::geography)::numeric END AS left_sqm, CASE WHEN s.id < e.id THEN ST_Area(e.footprint::geography)::numeric ELSE ST_Area(s.footprint::geography)::numeric END AS right_sqm, (s.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.tenant_id) AS cross_tenant FROM estates s JOIN estates e ON e.id <> s.id AND e.deleted = false AND e.footprint IS NOT NULL -- Index-backed candidate narrowing ONLY. Not the decision. AND ST_Intersects(s.footprint, e.footprint) WHERE s.id = p_estate_id AND s.deleted = false AND s.footprint IS NOT NULL ), -- The decision: real shared area in square metres, above the -- sliver threshold. Two estates meeting along a boundary -- produce an intersection of zero area and never reach here. real_overlap AS ( SELECT * FROM candidate WHERE overlap_sqm > p_min_overlap_sqm ), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO listing_conflicts ( id, created_at, created_by, deleted, conflict_type, left_entity_id, right_entity_id, left_tenant_id, right_tenant_id, estate_id, overlap_area_sqm, left_overlap_pct, right_overlap_pct, severity, status, detected_at ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'detection', false, 'ESTATE_OVERLAP', left_id, right_id, left_tenant, right_tenant, NULL, round(overlap_sqm, 2), round(LEAST(overlap_sqm / NULLIF(left_sqm, 0) * 100, 100), 2), round(LEAST(overlap_sqm / NULLIF(right_sqm, 0) * 100, 100), 2), CASE WHEN cross_tenant THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END, 'OPEN', now() FROM real_overlap r -- A reviewer's dismissal stands while the overlap it was -- made against is unchanged. Two things must BOTH be -- true for a dismissal to suppress a fresh conflict: -- 1. it was a dismissal of a STILL-OVERLAPPING pair -- (geometry_cleared_at IS NULL) — the reviewer -- judged that overlap acceptable. A dismissal made -- after the boundary was corrected accepted a -- correction, not an overlap, so it blesses -- nothing: if the boundary is put back, that is a -- new conflict (the revert-after-clearance case). -- 2. the overlap area is unchanged within the sliver -- threshold — a materially different overlap is a -- different situation and gets looked at again. -- A pair with a live conflict always passes through, so -- the ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE branch keeps refreshing it. -- AUTO_RESOLVED never suppresses: nobody decided anything. WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM listing_conflicts live WHERE live.conflict_type = 'ESTATE_OVERLAP' AND live.left_entity_id = r.left_id AND live.right_entity_id = r.right_id AND live.deleted = false AND live.status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING', 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE') ) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM listing_conflicts d WHERE d.conflict_type = 'ESTATE_OVERLAP' AND d.left_entity_id = r.left_id AND d.right_entity_id = r.right_id AND d.deleted = false AND d.status = 'DISMISSED' AND d.geometry_cleared_at IS NULL AND abs(d.overlap_area_sqm - round(r.overlap_sqm, 2)) <= p_min_overlap_sqm ) ON CONFLICT (conflict_type, left_entity_id, right_entity_id) WHERE deleted = false AND status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING', 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE') DO UPDATE SET overlap_area_sqm = EXCLUDED.overlap_area_sqm, left_overlap_pct = EXCLUDED.left_overlap_pct, right_overlap_pct = EXCLUDED.right_overlap_pct, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, -- A genuine re-overlap after a previous clearance -- means that clearance was stale (or reversed) — -- withdraw the signal rather than leave a false -- "this looked fixed" mark on an actively -- overlapping conflict. geometry_cleared_at = NULL, updated_at = now() -- status is deliberately absent: CD-8. A Super Admin -- halfway through an investigation keeps it through a -- re-scan. RETURNING 1 ), -- CD-9, MEDIUM only. Same tenant, nobody at risk of paying -- the wrong party — the geometry signal is trusted alone, -- same as the plain reading of CD-9 intended. The record is -- kept and marked, never deleted. auto_resolved_medium AS ( UPDATE listing_conflicts c SET status = 'AUTO_RESOLVED', resolved_at = now(), updated_at = now(), resolution_reason = 'Boundary geometry no longer overlaps. ' || 'Resolved automatically when detection re-ran.' WHERE c.conflict_type = 'ESTATE_OVERLAP' AND c.deleted = false AND c.severity = 'MEDIUM' AND c.status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING') AND (c.left_entity_id = p_estate_id OR c.right_entity_id = p_estate_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM real_overlap r WHERE r.left_id = c.left_entity_id AND r.right_id = c.right_entity_id ) RETURNING 1 ), -- HIGH, or anything a human has confirmed a duplicate at -- any severity: geometry alone must never lift the block. -- Record the clearance; leave status untouched, so the -- publication summary function (which counts by status, -- not by this column) is completely unaffected until a -- Super Admin reviews and dismisses it. geometry_cleared AS ( UPDATE listing_conflicts c SET geometry_cleared_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE c.conflict_type = 'ESTATE_OVERLAP' AND c.deleted = false AND (c.severity = 'HIGH' OR c.status = 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE') AND c.status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING', 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE') AND c.geometry_cleared_at IS NULL AND (c.left_entity_id = p_estate_id OR c.right_entity_id = p_estate_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM real_overlap r WHERE r.left_id = c.left_entity_id AND r.right_id = c.right_entity_id ) RETURNING 1 ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted)::integer; $$;
